name: New Year Print: Rooster Brings "Fu Gui" ("Wealth") and an Auspicious Pendant Couplet Reading "Tian Xia Tong Chun" ("Everyone Shares the Same Spring")
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；early 20th century；Woodblock print; ink and color on paper; with printed shop inscription reading "Hua Dian" ("print shop") at bottom right. Probably from Xi'an, Shaanxi; probable pair with 1935.37.99.
